# Design System

Define reusable tokens for:
- Typography.
- Spacing.
- Border radius.
- Elevation.
- Colors and semantic states.
- Control heights.
- Breakpoints.

Create consistent components for buttons, inputs, tables, cards, dialogs, alerts, navigation, and empty/loading states.
Favor consistency over one-off styling.
